# Hukam Labs

> An independent open-source technology lab building practical AI, creative, developer, and automation tools.

Hukam Labs is an independent technology initiative founded and engineered by Waleed Ahmad ("Hukam"), an independent software developer and AI pipeline specialist based in Pakistan (PSEB Registered Freelancer).

The lab's core philosophy is: **"Useful software should be accessible."**

We engineer standalone desktop applications, browser extensions, and local AI pipelines that run directly on consumer hardware — without forced subscriptions, telemetry tracking, or artificial paywalls. All projects are published openly on GitHub under permissive licenses (MIT and GPL).

## Contact & Profile Information

- Website: https://labs.likehukam.com/

## Flagship & Core Projects

- [Hukam Flow](https://labs.likehukam.com/projects/hukam-flow/): Modern Chrome Manifest V3 workflow automation tool and queue runner for Google Flow (flow.google.com). Features a dedicated Chrome Side Panel, MAIN-world Angular event synthesis, real-time internal batchexecute API interception, tab-scoped state isolation, and automated prompt-indexed downloads. Status: Active (v6.3.1). Repository: https://github.com/hellohukam/hukam-flow. License: MIT.
- [Hukam AI Upscaler Pro](https://labs.likehukam.com/projects/hukam-ai-upscaler/): Hardware-accelerated desktop super-resolution software for Windows x64 powered by Real-ESRGAN Vulkan NCNN. Pre-bundles neural weights (realesrgan-x4plus, anime, videov3) in a standalone 55MB executable without requiring Python or CUDA drivers. Supports crash-resilient resume logging and low-VRAM tile splitting. Status: Active (v1.0.0). Repository: https://github.com/hellohukam/hukam-ai-upscaler. License: MIT.
- [SVG Magic Cleaner](https://labs.likehukam.com/projects/svg-magic-cleaner/): 100% private in-browser AI background remover and raster-to-SVG vectorizer using Hugging Face Transformers.js and WebGPU with WASM fallback. Runs briaai/RMBG-1.4 directly in the browser with zero cloud uploads. Status: Active (v1.0.0). Repository: https://github.com/hellohukam/svg-magic-cleaner. License: MIT.
- [AI Image Forensic Repair](https://labs.likehukam.com/projects/ai-image-forensic-repair/): Standalone Windows desktop restoration utility solving the Adobe Illustrator 'File format cannot be placed' error caused by malformed AI generator headers (Midjourney, ComfyUI, Automatic1111). Rebuilds missing IEND/EOI markers and normalizes sRGB/RGBA buffers. Status: Active (v1.1.0). Repository: https://github.com/hellohukam/ai-image-forensic-repair. License: MIT.
- [Vector Craft Studio](https://labs.likehukam.com/projects/vector-craft-studio/): Full-stack raster-to-vector studio featuring multi-layer color quantization (2–32 discrete layers) and pure TypeScript Potrace Bézier curve tracing with real-time split-screen previews. Status: Active (v1.0.0). Repository: https://github.com/hellohukam/vector-craft-studio. License: MIT.
- [BiRefNet Pro BG Remover](https://labs.likehukam.com/projects/birefnet-bg-remover/): High-resolution desktop background removal tool powered by the BiRefNet bilateral reference network with Windows DirectML GPU acceleration for fine hair and alpha transparency. Status: Active (v1.0.0). Repository: https://github.com/hellohukam/birefnet-bg-remover. License: MIT.
- [AI Prompt EXIF Extractor Pro](https://labs.likehukam.com/projects/ai-prompt-exif-extractor/): Batch desktop utility parsing PNG and JPG chunks to extract embedded generation prompts, A1111 parameters, seeds, and ComfyUI workflow JSON graphs. Status: Active (v1.0.0). Repository: https://github.com/hellohukam/ai-prompt-exif-extractor. License: MIT.
- [Batch SVG Sanitizer Pro](https://labs.likehukam.com/projects/batch-svg-sanitizer/): Headless Windows batch tool stripping proprietary editor namespaces (Illustrator, Inkscape, Figma), redundant metadata, and orphaned clipPaths to optimize SVGs for stock marketplaces and web deployment. Status: Active (v1.0.0). Repository: https://github.com/hellohukam/batch-svg-sanitizer. License: MIT.

## Additional Creative Utilities

- [Hukam AI Creative Studio](https://github.com/hellohukam/hukam-ai-creative-studio): Full-stack image studio powered by Together AI (FLUX.1 Schnell) with a 4-key rotation pool and PostgreSQL gallery. Status: In Development.
- [Color Palette Extractor Pro](https://github.com/hellohukam/image-color-palette-extractor): High-speed Octree color quantization tool extracting dominant HEX palettes in bulk. Status: Active.
- [Hukam Automation Tools](https://github.com/hellohukam/hukam-automation-tools): Digital creator CLI automation suite for batch asset repair, FLUX, and metadata. Status: Complete.
- [Vector Metadata Injector](https://github.com/hellohukam/vector-metadata-injector): Embeds stock marketplace compliant IPTC/XMP/Dublin Core metadata directly into vector files. Status: Complete.
- [Stock Metadata CSV Generator](https://github.com/hellohukam/stock-metadata-csv-generator): Scans media directories and compiles pre-formatted submission CSVs for Adobe Stock and Shutterstock. Status: Complete.
- [Smart Asset Organizer](https://github.com/hellohukam/smart-asset-organizer): Rule-based directory classifier organizing large unstructured creative asset downloads. Status: Complete.
- [U2Net BG Remover](https://github.com/hellohukam/u2net-bg-remover): Lightweight CPU-optimized salient background removal desktop tool. Status: Complete.
- [YT Audio Extractor GUI](https://github.com/hellohukam/yt-audio-extractor-gui): Desktop GUI extracting lossless audio streams with ID3 metadata preservation. Status: Complete.

## Engineering Principles

1. **Local & Private Execution**: Processing happens locally on the user's GPU, CPU, or browser sandbox. No user data, prompts, or images are transmitted to external servers.
2. **Accessible by Default**: Useful tools are distributed without forced subscription tiers, artificial feature gating, or telemetry trackers.
3. **Genuine Open Source**: Codebases are hosted on GitHub under permissive licenses (MIT and GPL). Anyone may inspect, audit, fork, or build from source.
4. **Engineering over Hype**: Projects are built to solve real workflow bottlenecks, not to market speculative AI promises.
